AlertDialog.what: A modal confirmation dialog for destructive or irreversible actions, requiring explicit user confirmation or cancellation before dismissing.

AppShell.what: Top-level application wrapper that composes header, side navigation, and scrollable main content into a responsive page shell with auto mobile drawer support.

AspectRatio.what: A container that enforces a fixed width/height ratio for its child (image, video, embed, placeholder), optionally clipping to a circle/ellipse and controlling how the child fills the box.

Avatar.what: A circular/rounded/square user representation showing a profile image, fallback image, or initials, with optional status indicator, tooltip, and link behavior.

AvatarGroup.what: Container that stacks multiple Avatar children into an overlapping facepile, optionally ending with an overflow '+N' indicator, and manages roving keyboard focus when avatars are interactive.

AvatarGroupOverflow.what: The '+N' overflow indicator slot placed as the last child of an AvatarGroup to show how many additional avatars aren't displayed, optionally clickable to reveal more.

AvatarStatusDot.what: A size-aware status indicator dot (online/offline/busy etc.) rendered inside an Avatar's status slot, using distinct shapes per variant for colorblind-accessible status signaling.

Badge.what: A small inline label for showing status, counts, or categorical tags, with color variants and an optional icon.

Banner.what: A prominent status message block (info/warning/error/success) shown at the top of a page or form, optionally dismissable, with collapsible extra content, actions, and card or section styling.

BaseTypeahead.what: Headless combobox engine (input, search, keyboard nav, dropdown) with no wrapper styling, used internally to build styled typeahead/tokenizer components.

Blockquote.what: A styled semantic blockquote element for quoted text, with an optional cite/attribution line, used for rendering quotations in content.

BottomSheet.what: A mobile-style panel that slides up from the bottom of the screen in a native dialog, used for focused flows or supplementary content on top of the page.

BottomSheetSwitcher.what: A coordinator that manages multiple BottomSheet children as a single mutually-exclusive flow, animating handoff transitions between them inside one shared native dialog.

BreadcrumbItem.what: An individual link or current-page label within a Breadcrumbs trail, optionally acting as a dropdown-menu trigger instead of a plain link.

Breadcrumbs.what: A navigation component that renders a trail of BreadcrumbItem links in semantic nav/ol markup to show the user's location in a hierarchy.

Button.what: The core clickable action control supporting variants, sizes, icons, loading/async states, and optional link rendering.

ButtonGroup.what: A container that visually connects and groups multiple Button/IconButton children with shared borders, orientation, and roving-tabindex keyboard navigation.

Calendar.what: A calendar component for picking a single date or a date range with month navigation, constraints, and keyboard/grid accessibility.

Card.what: A generic container surface with themed background, optional border, radius, elevation, padding, and sizing — used as the base building block for grouped content.

Carousel.what: A horizontal scrollable container with edge fade masks, optional prev/next nav buttons, snap scrolling, and wrap-around looping for sliding through a set of items.

Center.what: A layout component that centers its children on one or both flex axes, with optional sizing and padding.

ChatComposer.what: A layout shell for building a chat message input box with slots for drawer, header, footer actions, send button, and status messages, used to compose/send chat messages.

ChatComposerDrawer.what: A collapsible drawer panel attached above a chat composer for showing attachments, context chips, or previews, with expand/collapse disclosure behavior.

ChatComposerInput.what: A rich contentEditable input for chat composers supporting @ mentions/slash-command trigger menus, inline token chips, message history, paste/drop file handling, and Enter-to-submit.

ChatDictationButton.what: A microphone toggle button for voice input in a chat composer that shows volume-reactive equalizer bars while listening, driven by a useChatDictation/useSpeechRecognition hook.

ChatLayout.what: A full-page layout shell for chat interfaces that places messages in normal page flow and docks the composer to the bottom behind a frosted-glass surface, with built-in auto-scroll and a scroll-to-bottom button.

ChatLayoutScrollButton.what: A floating pill button, used inside ChatLayout's dock, that fades in/out to let users jump to the latest message and can expand to show a 'new messages' label.

ChatMessage.what: A per-sender wrapper for a single chat message that handles avatar, name, alignment (left/right/center) and layout by sender role (assistant/user/system), used inside a ChatMessageList.

ChatMessageBubble.what: A styled content container that renders the visual 'chat bubble' around a single message's content, auto-styling its background based on the sender read from the parent ChatMessage context.

ChatMessageList.what: A presentational, scrollable-log container (role='log') that lays out ChatMessage children with density-based spacing, optional bottom alignment, empty state, and infinite-scroll-to-top loading.

ChatMessageMetadata.what: A small composable row for displaying a chat message's timestamp, footer content, and delivery status (with icon and separators), used inside a ChatMessage/ChatMessageBubble.

ChatSendButton.what: A circular send/stop toggle button for a chat composer that reads state from ChatComposerContext by default but can be used standalone.

ChatSystemMessage.what: A centered, muted banner-style message for chat threads used for non-sender notices like date separators or status updates, not for user/assistant bubbles.

ChatTokenizedText.what: Renders a plain text string in a chat message bubble, replacing matched token values (e.g. @mentions) with inline Badge or custom rendered content, sharing token definitions with the composer input.

ChatToolCalls.what: A chat UI component that renders LLM tool/function call invocations, showing a single inline call or a collapsible summary/group for multiple calls with status icons, duration, and diff stats.

CheckboxInput.what: A single checkbox form control supporting checked/unchecked/indeterminate states, label, description, loading/async change, disabled reasons with tooltip, and status messaging; use for one boolean/tri-state field.

CheckboxList.what: A grouped, accessible checkbox field (role=group) for multi-value selection, composing Field (label/description/status) and List (density/dividers) with context for its CheckboxListItem children.

CheckboxListItem.what: A checkbox row for use inside CheckboxList (collection mode) or standalone inside List, with label, description, and loading/disabled states.

Citation.what: An inline reference marker (numbered badge or labeled chip with source title/icon) that links out to a cited source, used for footnotes/references in text.

ClickableCard.what: An interactive card (built on Card) that acts as a single navigation link or click/action target, with proper accessible role via a hidden button/anchor, safe to nest other interactive elements inside.

Code.what: Inline monospace code span used within text for short code snippets, variable names, or commands.

CodeBlock.what: A read-only, syntax-highlighted code display block with optional line numbers, diff highlighting, collapsibility, and copy-to-clipboard, used to show code snippets in docs, chat, or IDE-like UIs.

Collapsible.what: A primitive that renders a trigger and content region where clicking the trigger toggles visibility of the content, used for expandable sections like FAQs or settings panels.

CollapsibleGroup.what: A context provider that coordinates open/close state across multiple Collapsible items, enabling accordion-style single or multiple-open behavior, optionally rendering dividers between items.

CommandPalette.what: A modal dialog shell (Cmd+K style) that searches/filters a list of commands or items via a pluggable searchSource and lets the user select one, with built-in keyboard navigation.

CommandPaletteEmpty.what: The empty-state message shown inside CommandPalette's list area when there are no bootstrap items or no search results.

CommandPaletteFooter.what: The footer row of a CommandPalette showing keyboard hint badges (arrows/enter/escape) or custom footer content.

CommandPaletteGroup.what: A visual grouping container with a heading label used to organize related items inside a CommandPaletteList.

CommandPaletteInput.what: The search/query input field for a command palette, with a search icon, loading spinner, and keyboard navigation wiring; use as the first child inside CommandPalette.

CommandPaletteItem.what: A single selectable, clickable option row inside a command palette list, supporting highlighted/selected/disabled states.

CommandPaletteList.what: Scrollable results container (listbox) for a command palette, rendering item/group children with correct ARIA roles.

ComplexSelector.what: A popover-based trigger/dropdown shell for building custom rich select controls (input, secondary, or ghost trigger styles) with fully custom popup content and an imperative open/close handle.

ContextMenu.what: A right-click (or long-press) context menu positioned at the cursor, with data-driven items or compound menuContent and adaptive bottom-sheet presentation on touch.

DateInput.what: A labeled text input with a calendar popover (or native date picker on touch) for selecting a single date, used inside forms.

DateRangeInput.what: A form control that opens a calendar popover for picking a start and end date together, with optional quick-select presets.

DateTimeInput.what: A combined date and time entry field with native or custom segmented inputs and an optional calendar/time popover, for selecting a precise date-time value.

Dialog.what: A modal (or inline) dialog surface built on the native <dialog> element, used to show overlay content like forms, confirmations, or detail views that interrupt the current flow.

DialogHeader.what: The header section for a Dialog, rendering an accessible auto-focused title, optional subtitle, and a close button, used inside Dialog/Layout composition.

Divider.what: A thin separator line (horizontal or vertical) used to visually divide sections of content, optionally with a centered label.

Drawer.what: A side-anchored overlay panel (inline start/end) built on native <dialog>, used for inspectors and detail views that float above page content without reflowing it, optionally with a scrim.

DrawerHeader.what: A header component for Drawer providing a title, optional subtitle, start/end content slots, and an optional close button, mirroring DialogHeader's API.

DropdownMenu.what: A trigger-activated menu component (button or custom trigger) showing a list of actions/options as a popover on desktop or a bottom sheet on mobile, supporting both data-driven items and composed JSX children, including submenus.

DropdownMenuCheckboxItem.what: A checkable row inside a DropdownMenu (role=menuitemcheckbox) used to toggle an independent boolean option without closing the menu by default.

DropdownMenuDivider.what: A horizontal separator line used inside a DropdownMenu to visually split groups of menu items.

DropdownMenuGroup.what: A titled, accessible grouping (role=group) of related rows inside a DropdownMenu, equivalent to the data API's section with a title.

DropdownMenuItem.what: An interactive, clickable row (role="menuitem") used inside a DropdownMenu to trigger an action or navigate to a link.

DropdownMenuRadioGroup.what: A container that groups DropdownMenuRadioItems into a single-select set (role="group"), owning the selected value and onChange state.

DropdownMenuRadioItem.what: A single selectable option (role="menuitemradio") within a DropdownMenuRadioGroup, showing a radio indicator and checked state.

DropdownMenuSubMenu.what: A dropdown/context-menu row that reveals a nested flyout (or drill-in view on touch) of its own menu items, for building multi-level navigation menus.

EmptyState.what: A placeholder UI shown when a content area (list, table, page) has no data, with an icon, title, description, and optional action buttons.

Field.what: A form field wrapper that pairs an accessible label, optional description, and status/error message around any input or control.

FieldLabel.what: Renders the label and optional description block for a form field, handling required/optional indicators, icons, tooltips, disabled state, and sr-only hiding; used internally by Field, CheckboxInput, and Switch rather than directly by app code.

FieldStatus.what: Displays a validation/status message (warning, error, success) below or attached to a form control, with icon and screen-reader announcement, used by Field, Switch, and CheckboxInput to show inline feedback.

FileInput.what: A form control for selecting one or more files via a native file picker or drag-and-drop dropzone, with validation (type/size/count), loading state, and status messaging.

FormLayout.what: A container that arranges form fields with consistent spacing and direction (vertical, horizontal, or horizontal with labels), providing layout context to child fields.

Grid.what: A CSS Grid-based layout container for arranging children into fixed or responsive columns with configurable gaps, alignment, and sizing.

GridSpan.what: A grid item wrapper used as a direct child of Grid to make that item span multiple columns and/or rows.

HStack.what: A layout component that arranges its children in a horizontal row, as a convenience wrapper around Stack with direction set to horizontal; use it when you need flexbox-row style layout with consistent spacing and alignment.

Heading.what: A semantic heading element (h1–h6) with themed typography styling, used for page/section titles and display-scale headlines, supporting truncation with tooltip.

HoverCard.what: A layer component that wraps a trigger element and shows floating content on hover, focus, or touch, like a tooltip with richer interactive content.

Icon.what: Renders a themed icon either from a semantic registry name or a passed-in SVG component, with consistent sizing, color, and accessibility handling.

IconButton.what: A thin wrapper over Button for rendering an icon-only, square button with a required accessible label, used for compact actions like toolbar icons or close/settings buttons.

InputGroup.what: Wraps an input with prefix/suffix addons (icons, text, buttons) into a visually connected control with a shared border, label, and status, used when you need something like a currency-prefixed text input or search box with a button.

InputGroupText.what: A non-interactive text/icon addon rendered inside an InputGroup to label or annotate an adjacent input, like a prefix ('https://') or suffix ('.com').

InternationalizationProvider.what: A context provider that supplies a locale, message catalogs, and text-direction to all Astryx components in its subtree so they render localized strings.

Item.what: A core list-row layout primitive for building rows/list items with label, description, start/end content slots, selection, links, and optional swipe actions.

Kbd.what: Renders a styled keyboard shortcut indicator (like <kbd> elements) for displaying key combinations in UI such as tooltips, menus, or docs.

Layout.what: A five-slot (header, start, content, end, footer) layout primitive for arranging regions within a page or bounded container, with built-in padding collapse, scroll containment, and RTL support.

LayoutContent.what: The scrollable main content slot for Layout, providing automatic scroll containment and context-aware padding for the primary body area.

LayoutFooter.what: The bottom bar/footer slot for Layout, used for action bars, pagination, or status bars with optional divider and padding control.

LayoutHeader.what: A fixed-height header slot component for Layout, used for page titles, app bars, or toolbars at the top of a layout region.

LayoutPanel.what: A fixed-width sidebar panel component for the start/end slots of Layout, used for navigation panels, settings sidebars, or detail/inspector panels.

Lightbox.what: A fullscreen modal overlay (built on native <dialog>) for viewing images or videos at full size, supporting single or gallery mode with navigation, zoom, and pan.

Link.what: An inline or standalone navigation anchor styled with the design system's typography, supporting external-link indicators, disabled states, and custom routing components; use for text-based navigation links.

LinkProvider.what: A context provider that sets the default link component (e.g. Next.js Link, React Router Link) used by all Astryx components rendering links in its subtree.

List.what: A vertical container for rendering a collection of ListItem rows with configurable density, dividers, marker styles, and edge/padding treatment; use to group related items like settings rows or menu entries.

ListItem.what: A single row within a List, supporting label, description, start/end content, markers/checkboxes, click or link behavior, selection and disabled states; use as the child rows of a List.

Markdown.what: Renders a markdown string as formatted rich content (headings, lists, tables, code blocks, links, citations) with optional streaming and plugin support; use for chat messages, docs, or any user-facing markdown text.

MediaTheme.what: A layout-neutral wrapper component that inverts semantic color tokens for children rendered on a surface of different luminance (e.g. dark background), used inside things like Toast or Overlay.

MetadataList.what: A read-only labeled key-value list (definition list) for displaying metadata fields, with configurable columns, orientation, and show-more collapsing; use for detail pages, sidebars, or property panels.

MetadataListItem.what: A single label/value row or pair inside a MetadataList, rendered as dt/dd with optional icon; use to populate MetadataList with individual metadata entries.

MobileNav.what: A full-height slide-out drawer overlay for mobile navigation, rendered via native <dialog>, used as the mobile counterpart to SideNav when a responsive app shell needs a collapsible nav drawer.

MoreMenu.what: An overflow 'more options' button (three-dot icon trigger) that opens a dropdown menu of actions, used for secondary actions in toolbars, cards, lists, or nav items.

MultiSelector.what: A multi-select combobox/dropdown field that lets users pick multiple options via checkboxes, shown as badges/chips in the trigger, with search, select-all, sections, and creatable options.

NavIcon.what: A small circular, accent-colored icon container used as a logo/brand mark inside TopNav or PageNav headers.

NumberInput.what: A labeled numeric text field with optional increment/decrement steppers, units, validation status, and icons, used for quantity, currency, and other numeric form inputs.

Outline.what: A scroll-spy table-of-contents navigation component that renders a list of document headings with an animated active indicator and keyboard navigation, used for in-page nav on long documentation/article pages.

OverflowList.what: A horizontal (or bounded multi-row) list layout that automatically hides items which don't fit in the available width and shows a customizable overflow indicator, used for toolbars, tag lists, and filter chips that need to collapse gracefully.

Overlay.what: A component that wraps media or content with a scrim overlay and shows additional content on top, like a hover caption on an image or card.

Pagination.what: A standalone navigation control for paging through lists or tables of content, supporting page numbers, compact text, dots, or count display, with optional page size selection.

Popover.what: A click-triggered, anchored floating panel for showing interactive content (forms, menus, settings) next to a trigger button, with focus trapping and light dismiss.

PowerSearch.what: A token-based structured search/filter bar where users pick fields and operators from a config to build composable filter tokens, for advanced search and filtering UIs like data tables or consoles.

ProgressBar.what: A horizontal bar showing determinate or indeterminate progress toward completion, used for loading states, task progress, or scorecards/dashboards.

RadioList.what: An accessible group of radio buttons for selecting a single value from a list of mutually exclusive options, used in forms like payment, checkout, or wizard steps.

RadioListItem.what: A single selectable row within a RadioList, combining a radio input with label, description, and optional start/end content; use it for one option in a radio group list.

ScrollableArea.what: A native scroll viewport wrapper that manages axis, accessibility, sizing, overscroll, and content padding for scrollable regions; use it when you need an accessible, configurable scroll container around content.

Section.what: A background/visual container component used to create distinct, padded regions within a page or card, with configurable variant, sizing, padding, and dividers.

SegmentedControl.what: A single-selection radio-group styled as a row of connected buttons (segments), used for switching between a small set of mutually exclusive views or options.

SegmentedControlItem.what: A single radio-style segment button used inside a SegmentedControl to let users choose one of a small visible set.

SelectableCard.what: A Card-based interactive card with a hidden checkbox for toggling selection state (single/multi-select), showing an inset accent ring when selected.

Selector.what: A dropdown/combobox form control for selecting one or more options from a list, with trigger styles (input, secondary, ghost) and support for icons, search, and grouping.

SelectorOption.what: A layout helper component used inside Selector's renderOption to render a custom option row with icon, label, description, and end content consistently styled.

SideNav.what: A sidebar navigation container with sticky header/topContent, scrollable body, and sticky footer/footerIcons zones, optionally resizable and collapsible; use as the main app sidebar in a layout shell.

SideNavCollapseButton.what: A toggle button that collapses/expands a SideNav, reading collapse state from context by default or from an explicit controlled config when placed outside the SideNav.

SideNavHeading.what: A product/suite/account heading block for the SideNav header area, optionally linking to a page or opening a switcher menu popover (e.g. workspace/product switcher).

SideNavItem.what: A single navigation row (link or button) used inside SideNav, supporting icons, selected state, nesting/children, row actions, and collapsed icon-only rail mode.

SideNavSection.what: A labeled grouping container for a set of SideNavItems inside a SideNav, with optional title, subtitle, and end content, and a hideable header.

Skeleton.what: A pulsing placeholder block used to indicate loading content before the real UI renders, sizable with configurable width/height/radius and staggered animation.

Slider.what: A draggable track-and-thumb control for selecting a numeric value or range within min/max bounds, used instead of a text input when the user should drag/slide to a value.

Spinner.what: An animated circular loading indicator shown while content or an action is in progress, used inline or in a button/page to communicate indeterminate wait state.

Stack.what: A polymorphic flex-layout component that arranges children horizontally or vertically with configurable gap, alignment, padding, sizing, and scrolling, replacing separate HStack/VStack usage.

StatusDot.what: A small fixed-size colored dot used to indicate a status (online/offline, success/warning/error, etc.) next to a label or avatar.

Step.what: A single step item used inside a Stepper to represent one stage of a multi-step flow, showing an indicator, label, description, and optional content.

Stepper.what: A container component that lays out a sequence of Step children (horizontal or vertical) with progress indicators and connectors, used for multi-step workflows like wizards and checkouts.

Switch.what: A toggle control for switching a single setting on or off, used in forms, settings panels, and tables where an immediate binary choice is needed.

Tab.what: A single selectable tab item (button or link) used inside a TabList, for switching panels or navigating between sections.

TabList.what: A tab strip container that provides tab navigation context (selected value, size) to Tab/TabMenu children, handling roving-tabindex keyboard nav and horizontal overflow scrolling; use it to build primary navigation or content-switching tab bars.

TabMenu.what: An overflow menu trigger rendered inside a TabList that opens a dropdown of additional tab options when there isn't room to show every tab, mirroring the selected-tab indicator styling.

Table.what: A styled, data-driven table component for rendering rows/columns with configurable density, dividers, striping, and hover states; use it as the primary way to display tabular data.

TableBody.what: A thin styled wrapper around the native <tbody> element used when composing a Table manually in children mode.

TableCell.what: A <td> wrapper used inside TableRow for manual/children-mode tables, inheriting density, dividers, and alignment from the parent Table context, with optional right-click context menu support.

TableFooter.what: A layout wrapper rendering a <tfoot> element for grouping footer rows (e.g. totals/summary rows) within a Table.

TableHeader.what: A layout wrapper rendering a <thead> element for grouping header rows within a Table.

TableHeaderCell.what: A styled <th> cell component for use inside a Table's header row, inheriting density/divider/font styling from table context, with optional context-menu actions.

TableRow.what: A table row wrapper (<tr>) used inside TableHeader/TableBody/TableFooter in children mode, inheriting striping/hover styling from Table context.

TableSelectionToolbar.what: A bulk-action toolbar that appears when table rows are selected, showing selected count and a clear-all button, built on top of Toolbar and useTableSelectionState.

Text.what: A semantic text primitive that renders type-based typography (body, label, supporting, code, display, etc.) with options for truncation, tooltip-on-truncate, color, weight, and alignment; use for any inline or block text content.

TextArea.what: A multi-line text input field for collecting longer-form user text, with label, status, icons, loading, and character counter support.

TextInput.what: A one-line text field for collecting user text/email/password values, with label, icons, status, clear button, and sizing.

Theme.what: A provider component that applies a design-system theme (tokens, color-scheme, component overrides) to its subtree, created via defineTheme().

Thumbnail.what: A small square preview card for an image attachment, showing a loading skeleton, the image, or a placeholder, with an optional overlaid remove button.

TimeInput.what: A labeled time-entry form field that lets users pick or type a time value (optionally with seconds), adapting between a typed text field and native/bottom-sheet pickers depending on pointer type.

Timer.what: A non-interactive, auto-updating display of elapsed time (stopwatch-style) since a given start time, without triggering React re-renders.

Timestamp.what: A component that renders a formatted date/time value as human-readable text (relative or absolute), with optional live updates and a hover card showing precise/multi-timezone details.

Toast.what: A single notification surface rendered inside a ToastViewport that auto-dismisses, pauses on hover/focus/window-blur, and supports swipe-to-dismiss.

ToggleButton.what: A controlled or group-integrated toggle button built on Button, for binary pressed/unpressed states like formatting controls, view switches, or favorite toggles.

ToggleButtonGroup.what: A container that groups ToggleButton children to provide single-select or multi-select toggle behavior, like view-mode switchers or multi-select formatting toolbars.

Token.what: A small chip/tag used to display an entity inline, optionally removable, clickable, or as a link, in colors indicating category/status.

Tokenizer.what: A multi-select typeahead input that lets users search and pick items, rendering each selection as a removable Token chip inside the field.

Toolbar.what: A horizontal or vertical container with start/center/end content slots that lays out and arranges action controls (buttons, inputs, tabs) with built-in roving-tabindex keyboard navigation.

Tooltip.what: A hover/focus-triggered floating label that shows short informative text next to a trigger element, used to add non-interactive hints or descriptions to UI elements.

TopNav.what: The top-level application header/navigation bar with heading, start/center/end content slots, that adapts into a mobile bar or drawer (MobileNav) on small screens.

TopNavHeading.what: A product/suite/account heading slot for TopNav, showing logo, heading/superheading/subheading text, and an optional dropdown menu popover with smart link/trigger boundary logic.

TopNavItem.what: A single horizontal navigation link/button for use in TopNav's startContent, supporting selected state, icon-only mode, and responsive drawer/mobile rendering.

TopNavMegaMenu.what: A TopNav navigation trigger that opens a full-width, hover/click-activated mega menu panel (with items + featured content slots), collapsing into a drill-down drawer section on mobile.

TopNavMegaMenuFeaturedCard.what: A standard promotional card (image, title, description, CTA link) for the featured slot inside a TopNavMegaMenu.

TopNavMegaMenuItem.what: A single selectable entry (icon, title, description, link) inside a TopNavMegaMenu that automatically adapts its layout between desktop popover grid and mobile drawer.

TopNavMenu.what: A top-nav navigation trigger that shows a hover-activated popover menu of rich items (icon/title/description) on desktop and collapses into an expandable drawer section on mobile.

TreeList.what: A hierarchical, data-driven tree view component for rendering nested/expandable lists (e.g. file trees, nav trees) with keyboard navigation and expand/collapse state.

Typeahead.what: Styled, accessible async-search combobox field (with label, status, icon, clear button) for selecting a single item from a search source.

TypeaheadItem.what: Default presentational row (icon, label, description) used to render each result in a Typeahead/BaseTypeahead dropdown, and reusable for custom renderItem implementations.

VStack.what: A convenience wrapper around Stack preset to vertical direction, for stacking items top-to-bottom.

VisuallyHidden.what: An accessibility primitive that renders content visible to screen readers but visually hidden, used for icon-only labels or aria-live announcement text.

useAnnounce.what: A hook returning an imperative function to announce messages to screen readers via persistent polite/assertive live regions.

useAppShellMobile.what: Context hook exposing mobile nav drawer state (open/close/toggle) to components inside an AppShell layout, used for adapting UI on small screens.

useClickableContainer.what: A hook that makes an entire container (like a card) clickable/navigable via href while ensuring clicks on nested interactive elements (buttons, links) don't trigger the container's action.

useClipboard.what: A hook that handles copy-to-clipboard logic — writing text, a transient 'copied' state with auto-reset, and a screen-reader announcement — for building copy buttons/icons.

useCollapsible.what: A headless hook that manages open/closed state for collapsible UI (like accordions or expandable cards), supporting uncontrolled, controlled, and group-controlled modes.

useCollator.what: Hook returning a locale-aware Intl.Collator (bound to the active i18n context) for correct string sorting/comparison.

useCombobox.what: A hook providing keyboard navigation, highlighting, and selection logic for combobox/listbox UI patterns, used internally by Selector and CommandPalette (also exports useSelectedItemOffset for positioning a dropdown over its trigger).

useContainerReveal.what: A headless CSS-only hook that reveals or conceals child content when a container is hovered or focused, used for things like row action buttons that appear on hover.

useDevWarning.what: A dev-only hook that fires a standardized 'Component: message' console warning once per mount when a given condition is true, used to surface guardrails/misuse from inside a component without causing re-renders.

useEntryAnimation.what: A hook that returns a StyleX entry-animation style (slide/fade/scale) applied only when an element is dynamically mounted after initial page load, not on initial paint or hydration.

useFocusTrap.what: A hook that traps keyboard focus inside a container (modal/dialog/popover pattern), redirects escaped Tab focus back in, restores focus on close, and integrates with the shared layer-dismissal stack for Escape handling.

useGridFocus.what: A hook that implements WAI-ARIA grid keyboard navigation (arrow keys, Home/End, Page Up/Down, optional roving tabindex) over a container's cell elements, used e.g. by a Calendar's date grid.

useHotkeys.what: A hook that registers global window-level keyboard shortcuts (e.g. ⌘K, Escape) with platform-aware modifiers, used for app-wide keyboard shortcuts.

useHoverCard.what: A hook that adds hover/focus-triggered popover ('hover card') behavior to a trigger element, showing rich content near it after a delay (e.g., a profile preview on hover).

useImageMode.what: A hook that analyzes an image's pixels via OffscreenCanvas to detect whether it is predominantly dark or light, useful for auto-choosing overlay text/theme color on top of images.

useImperativeAlertDialog.what: A hook that provides an imperative show/hide API for an AlertDialog (confirmation dialog) so you don't need to manage open state manually, and gives back a JSX element to render.

useImperativeDialog.what: A hook that gives you an imperative show()/hide() API for a Dialog instead of manually managing open-state and content, use when you want to pop up a dialog on demand (e.g. from a button click) without controlled state boilerplate.

useIndicatorFocusRing.what: A hook that imperatively paints a standard focus ring onto a themeable indicator element (e.g. a checkbox/radio's visual indicator) when its hidden native input is keyboard-focused, used when the focusable input is visually hidden and a third-party/themed indicator renders beside it.
synonyms: accessible focus ring for styled checkbox

useInputContainer.what: A hook for wiring click handlers on an input's wrapper div so clicking anywhere in the container (padding, icons) focuses or activates the real input/control inside, while not stealing focus from nested interactive elements like clear buttons.

useInputStatusIcon.what: A hook that renders the on-field status icon (warning/error/success) for bordered inputs like TextInput/TextArea/DateInput, adapting to the statusVariant (attached, detached, tooltip) and wiring up aria-describedby/tooltip accessibility.

useInteractiveRole.what: A hook that decides whether a polymorphic component should render as a link, a button, or an inert element based on href, onClick, disabled state, and surrounding interactive context.

useKeyboardHint.what: A hook that shows a temporary floating tooltip-like hint (e.g. '← → to navigate') anchored to the focused element when a composite roving-tabindex widget first receives keyboard focus, to teach sighted keyboard users the arrow-key interaction.

useLayer.what: A low-level positioning/overlay hook for building floating UI layers (tooltips, popovers, menus) anchored to a trigger element using CSS anchor positioning, or fixed-coordinate placement.

useListFocus.what: A hook that implements keyboard navigation (arrow keys, Home/End, Escape, optional roving tabindex) for a linear list of focusable items like a menu, toolbar, or button group.

useLocale.what: A hook that returns the active BCP 47 locale string from the i18n provider context, for use when feeding formatting helpers like date/number formatters or useCollator.

useLongPress.what: A touch-interaction hook that detects a single-finger long-press gesture (with movement/time tolerance) and fires a callback, used for invoking context menus on touch devices.

useMediaQuery.what: SSR-safe hook that returns whether a CSS media query currently matches, for responsive breakpoint logic.

useMenuPress.what: A low-level hook that implements the full press/gesture model for menu-like surfaces (menu root + trigger), handling pointer tracking, long-press opening, release-based activation, stray-click swallowing, and edge autoscroll.
synonyms: press and drag select menu item

useMergedRefs.what: A hook that combines multiple React refs (up to six) into a single stable callback ref, useful when one DOM element needs to be referenced by both your component and a forwarded/external ref.
synonyms: share ref between parent and child
combine forwarded ref with internal ref

useMultiCombobox.what: A hook providing keyboard navigation, highlighting, and toggle logic for a multi-select combobox/dropdown where selecting an item does not close the popup.

useOverflow.what: A hook that measures a hidden copy of a list to determine how many items fit in the visible container's width, enabling 'show N items + overflow indicator' patterns without flicker.

usePopover.what: A hook for building popover/dialog-like floating UI (e.g. date pickers, comboboxes) that combines anchored positioning, focus trapping, auto-focus, escape/light dismiss, and a hidden accessible close button.

usePressFeedback.what: A tiny hook to mark any custom pressable element so it participates in the shared document-level touch press visual feedback system (pressed overlay/flash on touch, :active for mouse).

useResizable.what: A hook that implements drag-to-resize behavior for one or more layout regions (e.g. sidebars/panels), with support for min/max sizes, collapsing, snapping, and persistence to localStorage.

useScrollLock.what: A hook that locks background page scrolling (e.g. while a modal/dialog is open) by pinning the body with position:fixed, working around iOS Safari limitations, and restores scroll position on unlock.

useScrollOverflow.what: A hook that attaches to a horizontally scrollable container and reports whether content overflows at the start/end edges, updating on scroll and resize, for use cases like fade edges or scroll buttons in carousels and tab lists.

useScrollableArea.what: A low-level behavior hook that adds logical (inline/block, writing-mode aware) scroll overflow state, native keyboard scroll delegation, and safe prop getters to caller-owned viewport/content elements, meant to power a ScrollableArea component or similar scroll-owning structures.

useStreamingText.what: Hook that smooths bursty streamed text (e.g. from an LLM) into a steady character-by-character reveal animation for display.

useTableColumnResize.what: A Table plugin hook that enables drag-to-resize (and keyboard resize) of table columns, handling proportional vs pixel column widths, min/max clamping, and committing resized widths back to the consumer; use when a Table needs resizable columns.

useTableColumnSettings.what: A pure Table plugin hook that filters and reorders a table's columns based on a provided active-column-keys config, used alongside useTableColumnSettingsState to implement show/hide and reorder column settings UI.

useTableFilterState.what: A hook that manages the filter-state object (map of column key to value) and an onFilterChange handler, meant to be paired with useTableFiltering so you don't write the setState boilerplate yourself.

useTableFiltering.what: A Table plugin hook that renders per-column filter controls (popover, inline, or inline-compact) driven by a PowerSearchConfig, resolving each column's filter field/operator into the right input (text, number, date, time, selector, multi-select, tokenizer), for use via the Table `plugins` prop.

useTableGroupedRows.what: A Table plugin hook that flattens grouped data into collapsible, full-width section-header rows (with chevron toggle and count) interleaved with the data rows, for use via the Table `plugins` and `idKey` props.

useTablePagination.what: A Table plugin hook that renders Pagination controls above and/or below a table, letting the consumer own page state while handling layout, alignment, and page-size selection.

useTableRowExpansion.what: A Table plugin hook that adds a chevron toggle and a full-width detail panel beneath a row, for showing extra content without a hierarchical tree structure.

useTableRowIndex.what: A Table plugin hook that prepends a right-aligned, monospaced row-number column reflecting the current sort/filter/pagination order.

useTableRowStatus.what: A Table plugin hook that prepends a narrow gutter column showing a per-row status indicator (dot or icon) derived from row data, with tooltip and accessible label.

useTableSelection.what: A Table plugin hook that adds a checkbox column for row selection and select-all, managing checkbox rendering, row highlighting, and aria-selected state via an external store for fine-grained updates.

useTableSelectionState.what: A state-management hook that computes selection config (selected/select-all/indeterminate logic, respecting disabled/non-selectable rows) for use with useTableSelection, given controlled selectedKeys state.

useTableSortable.what: A headless Table plugin hook that adds clickable, sortable column headers with ascending/descending/unsorted cycling and optional multi-column sort via shift-click.

useTableStickyColumns.what: A headless Table plugin hook that pins specified columns to the start and/or end edge of a scrollable table, keeping them visible with shadow indicators while other columns scroll horizontally.

useTableTreeData.what: A headless Table plugin hook that renders hierarchical/nested row data with expand/collapse chevrons, per-level indentation, and tree ARIA semantics inside a tree column.

useTableTreeState.what: A state-management hook for hierarchical table data that owns the expanded/collapsed row set (controlled or uncontrolled), flattens nested rows into a visible-only array, and produces a ready-to-use config for the useTableTreeData plugin — use it when a Table needs to render tree/nested data with expand/collapse rows.

useTheme.what: A hook that gives synchronous, non-CSS access to resolved design-token values (colors, spacing, etc.) and the current light/dark mode for use in canvas, SVG, or data-viz libraries, falling back to the root <html> theme attributes or OS preference when no Theme provider is present.
synonyms: resolve CSS variable to raw value

useToast.what: Imperative hook to show toast notifications from anywhere, working with or without a LayerProvider via a self-mounting fallback viewport.

useTooltip.what: Hook providing hover/focus/tap-triggered tooltip behavior with anchor positioning, built on useLayer, for short non-interactive hint text.

useTranslator.what: A hook that returns a stable translator function for translating strings outside of render, such as in event handlers or effects.

useTreeFocus.what: A hook implementing the WAI-ARIA tree keyboard navigation pattern (expand/collapse, parent/child movement, roving tabindex, typeahead) for a visible treeitem list like TreeList.

useTypeahead.what: A hook that adds press-a-letter-to-jump (type-to-focus) search to any list, menu, or grid by matching buffered keystrokes against item labels.
